title: Linearity and restriction of completed tensor sections
statement: Let ell be prime, E and L finite extensions of Q_ell, iota:E→L a coefficient inclusion, W a scheme in the coefficient universe, and M a sheaf of completed integral E-modules. In the ordinary scalar extension specified by [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison], completedScalarTensorSection(a,x) equals a times completedScalarTensorSection(1,x). For every morphism f:U→V of the opposite pro-etale site, restriction of completedScalarTensorSection(1,x) equals completedScalarTensorSection(1,M(f)(x)). These statements concern the actual sheafified tensor construction [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], including its canonical object transport.

source.place: Section 03EK (section-tensor-product); elementary linearity and naturality of the sheafification unit.

proof.text: First work with abstract ring sheaves R,S and a morphism phi:R→S. Transport the scalar extension object to the sheafification of the sectionwise tensor presheaf. The sheafification adjunction unit is S-linear, and a tensor x equals a times (1 tensor x) by tensor scalar multiplication and a*1=a. For restriction, naturality of this unit identifies restriction of the sheafified tensor with sheafification of the tensor restriction; the latter sends 1 tensor x to 1 tensor M(f)(x), because S(f) preserves one. Transport back along the specified object equality. Specialize to completed integral coefficient sheaves.

proof_origin.place: Section 03EK; explicit sectionwise calculation using the linear sheafification unit and its naturality.

theorem completedTensorSectionProperties
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L) (W : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.{u})
    (M : integralTowerModules l E W) :
    (∀ (U : W.ProEtᵒᵖ)
      (a : (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l L W).obj.obj U)
      (x : M.val.obj U),
      completedScalarTensorSection l E L ι W M U a x =
        a • completedScalarTensorSection l E L ι W M U 1 x) ∧
    (∀ {U V : W.ProEtᵒᵖ} (f : U ⟶ V) (x : M.val.obj U),
      (((completedOrdinaryScalarExtension l E L ι W).obj M).val.map f)
          (completedScalarTensorSection l E L ι W M U 1 x) =
        completedScalarTensorSection l E L ι W M V 1 (M.val.map f x))
